claim_summary: Coarse-moduli identification of the smooth-conic nine-line Ziegler incidence locus with an open genus-two even-spin locus; generic degree ten and stabilizer correspondence.
integrity: The source syzygy and even-theta classification are credited to their original literature; the claim is their new geometric incidence reconstruction and moduli identification. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Smooth conic, distinct branch vertices, and exact six-triple/eighteen-double incidence only; no claim for degenerate conics, boundary spin curves, or stacks. Literature overlap under classical invariant-theory aliases remains possible.
title: The smooth-conic Ziegler locus realizes an open genus-two even-spin moduli space
